license.notes: Licence not established for this documentation. Cloudflare's licence page (https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/reference/policies-compliances/licenses/, checked 2026-11-14) says the "Cloudflare Workers documentation website" is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0, but this glossary comes from the logs documentation (https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/glossary/), which that statement does not clearly cover. The LICENSE file of the cloudflare-docs GitHub repository (https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-docs/blob/production/LICENSE) says CC BY 4.0 instead, so Cloudflare's two statements conflict. Hosting here does not rest on either licence: Publicly accessible web resource with no login required (Tier 2 of Kurt Seifried 2026-11-09 4-tier hosting rule: open-web no-login content is mirrored in the public dataset repository with attribution).

tier_evidence.note: Glossary page reads with no login; the extracted term "log file" appears in it.
